stories.title: Our guide to every NFL Week 10 game: Matchup previews, predictions, picks and nuggets
stories.summary: Kirk Cousins' return to Minnesota? Patriots vs. Lions in Germany? There are 13 more games in Week 10, and we have picks, predictions and more for all of them.

stories.title: It's Mendoza time: Graziano on the Raiders' decision to sit the rookie QB ... until now
stories.summary: The Raiders had a plan for Fernando Mendoza in Year 1 and stuck to it as long as they could.

stories.title: Sources: Murray wants trade from Pelicans; both sides working on resolution
stories.summary: Pelicans guard Dejounte Murray wants a trade from the franchise, and his agent, Klutch Sports CEO Rich Paul, and team officials have started working on a resolution, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Chiefs RB Walker (groin) misses practice, status uncertain vs. Falcons
stories.summary: Chiefs running back Kenneth Walker III missed practice Friday with a sore groin, leaving his status for Sunday's matchup against the Falcons in question.

stories.title: Sources: Bauers parlays career season into 4-year, $58M contract with Red Sox
stories.summary: First baseman Jake Bauers, who is coming off a career season with the Brewers, has agreed to four-year, $58M contract with the Red Sox, sources told ESPN.
